scenes.visualDescription: Wide shot of a small English ship, the 'Roanoke', approaching the coast of North Carolina in 1587. The sky is partly cloudy, and the land is a dense forest. Settlers can be seen on the deck, looking towards the shore with anticipation and apprehension.
scenes.imagePrompt: English ship approaching North Carolina coast, 1587, dense forest, cloudy sky, settlers on deck, painting style

scenes.visualDescription: A bustling scene of English settlers building a small village on Roanoke Island in 1587. They are constructing wooden houses, planting crops, and interacting with the local Native Americans (peaceful interaction). The sun is shining.
scenes.imagePrompt: Roanoke Island, 1587, English settlers building village, wooden houses, crops, friendly interaction with Native Americans, sunny day, illustration

scenes.visualDescription: An empty, overgrown village on Roanoke Island. The houses are dilapidated, and the crops have withered. The scene is shrouded in mist and fog. The atmosphere is eerie and unsettling. A single crow sits atop a broken fence post.
scenes.imagePrompt: Abandoned Roanoke village, 1590, overgrown, dilapidated houses, withered crops, mist, eerie atmosphere, crow on fencepost, dark painting

scenes.visualDescription: Close-up of a weathered wooden post with the word 'CROATOAN' carved into it. The carving is old and worn, but still legible. The background is blurred, showing the dense forest surrounding the post.
scenes.imagePrompt: Weathered wooden post, carved with 'CROATOAN', close-up, blurry forest background, mysterious, aged wood texture
